title: The Mummy
description:
S1
An Egyptian mummy (Boris Karloff) searches Cairo for the girl (Zita Johann) he thinks is his long-lost princess.

title: The Mummy's Curse
description:
S1
Shipped to Louisiana, mummy Kharis and his princess roam the bayou.

title: The Mummy's Ghost
description:
S1
A 3000-year-old limping mummy (Lon Chaney) seeks his reincarnated princess (Ramsay Ames) in a Midwestern college town.

title: The Mummy's Hand
description:
S1
Archaeologists defile the tomb of mummified Kharis, who was buried alive for falling in love with an Egyptian princess.

title: The Mummy's Tomb
description:
S1
An old archaeologist recalls the mummy Kharis, now at large in New England.

title: Night Creatures
description:
S1
Pirate Captain Clegg (Peter Cushing), an English vicar by day, leads ghostly mounted smugglers by night.

title: Night Monster
description:
S1
A man (Lionel Atwill) uses mind over matter to replace his legs, then hunts the doctors who took them.

title: The Night Walker
description:
S1
A lawyer (Robert Taylor) advises a blind man's rich widow (Barbara Stanwyck) tormented by nightmares.

title: The People Under the Stairs
description:
S1
Hoping to find a fortune in gold, a boy instead discovers the horrific secrets lurking inside the home of two murderous siblings.

title: Phantom of the Opera
description:
S1
An acid-scarred composer (Claude Rains) rises from the Paris sewers to boost his favorite opera understudy's (Susanna Foster) career.

title: Phantom of the Opera
description:
S1
An acid-scarred composer (Herbert Lom) has his dwarf helper bring an opera singer (Heather Sears) to his London sewer hide-out.

title: Revenge of the Creature
description:
S1
Florida aquarium workers (John Agar, Lori Nelson, John Bromfield) communicate by cattle prod with a captured gill-man.

title: She-Wolf of London
description:
S1
Grisly murders convince a turn-of-the-century Londoner that she is the latest in a long line of werewolves.

title: Tremors
description:
S1
Four big worms with multiple tongues dig high-speed around people (Kevin Bacon, Fred Ward, Finn Carter) in the middle of nowhere.
